products.title: Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys: Positional Escapes by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Get Out Of Bad Positions On The Mat With No Speed, Flexibility, Or Athleticism Needed With These Techniques Designed For Older Grapplers From 5-Time Black Belt World Champion Bernardo Faria

  • Make your escapes as strong as possible so that you stop getting stuck in mount, side control, back control, and more
  • Bernardo Faria won 5 black belt IBJJF World Championships using these systems - and now he teaches every detail so it can help you
  • Use techniques like the upa escape, the half guard escape, the scissor escape, and many more - all of them great for older grapplers
  • This series is a huge honor for him :)
  • Get every detail you’ll need so that older grapplers can still find effective ways to get out of all of Jiu-Jitsu’s most common pinning positions


Get Out Of Bad Positions On The Mat With No Speed, Flexibility, Or Athleticism Needed With These Techniques Designed For Older Grapplers From 5-Time Black Belt World Champion Bernardo Faria

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn? 

Join one of the best black belt competitors ever as Bernardo Faria shows you how OLDER and SLOWER grapplers can get out of all of BJJ’s most common pinning positions on this new 4-part instructional series all about how you can stop getting stuck and start getting out. With Bernardo teaching you all the best techniques, including common mistakes to avoid, you’ll see how an older grappler can best get out of mount, back, side control, and more.

Bernardo Faria was always unique as a black belt for having tons of success against the best in the world by using the half guard and relying on techniques that were usually for older guys in the room. Still, he was able to work these positions and study them until he could attack all the time with them - and he turned these moves into systems that helped him win 5 world championships at black belt, including an absolute championship in 2015.

Join Bernardo as he teaches an older grappler these lessons in real-time, showing him how to perform them so that you can watch how you can improve rapidly. You will get techniques for escaping side control, mount, back, turtle, and more - using movements that don’t need you to be fast or strong or flexible.

products.title: Fast Track BJJ: Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys - Submission Escapes by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Fast Track BJJ makes that instruction even easier to study.

Instead of hours of unnecessary complexity, this series is designed to deliver Bernardo's most important concepts and techniques in a shorter, more focused format at a better price point. Get the information you need, take it to the mat, and start improving immediately.

  • Survive dangerous submission situations and get back to safety with 5X Black Belt World Champion Bernardo Faria’s practical approach to submission escapes designed specifically for older grapplers!
  • Learn the concepts and techniques Bernardo recommends for dealing with common submission threats without relying on explosive movement, extreme flexibility, or superior athleticism.
  • Develop a smarter defensive game that helps you recognize danger earlier, stay calm under pressure, and systematically work your way out of bad situations.
  • Discover Bernardo’s approach to efficient, reliable escapes that can work for recreational grapplers, older practitioners, and anyone who wants jiu jitsu built around technique instead of physical attributes.


What will You Learn?

Getting older doesn't mean you have to accept getting submitted—you just need a smarter way to escape.

In Fast Track BJJ: Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys – Submission Escapes, 5X Black Belt World Champion Bernardo Faria shows you how to survive some of jiu jitsu's most dangerous situations with a defensive approach built for grapplers who don't want to depend on speed, flexibility, or explosive athleticism.

Submission defense becomes increasingly important as you get older. Scrambling wildly out of an armbar or trying to explosively rip yourself free from a bad position isn't just inefficient—it can be a recipe for injury.

Bernardo's approach is different.

Learn how to stay composed, understand the position you're in, protect yourself from the immediate threat, and use simple, technically sound movements to systematically work toward safety.

This is the same philosophy that has made Bernardo's Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys instruction so popular. Rather than trying to make an older grappler move like a 20-year-old competitor, Bernardo adapts jiu jitsu around the realities of longevity, efficiency, and intelligent movement.

And there may be no situation where that philosophy matters more than submission defense.

As a 5X Black Belt World Champion, Bernardo reached the highest levels of competitive jiu jitsu using a game famous for being systematic, pressure-oriented, and incredibly efficient. Today, he's become one of BJJ Fanatics' most trusted instructors for older, less athletic, and recreational grapplers looking for techniques they can actually use.

Fast Track BJJ makes that instruction even easier to study.

Instead of hours of unnecessary complexity, this series is designed to deliver Bernardo's most important concepts and techniques in a shorter, more focused format at a better price point. Get the information you need, take it to the mat, and start improving immediately.

You can't guarantee that you'll never get caught in a submission—but you can make yourself much harder to finish.

Build smarter defense, protect your body, and develop submission escapes designed to keep your jiu jitsu effective for years to come with Fast Track BJJ: Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys – Submission Escapes by Bernardo Faria.

products.title: Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Six complete Fast Track BJJ courses from Bernardo Faria, built for the grappler who wants to roll smart, stay safe and keep beating younger, stronger training partners.

  • All 6 Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys courses from the Fast Track BJJ series in one bundle
  • A complete game: pressure passing, half guard, escapes from every bad position and high-percentage control and submissions
  • Low-risk, energy-saving techniques that work when you are not the most athletic person on the mat


What Will You Learn?

Bernardo Faria is a five-time IBJJF black belt World Champion, and his game was never built on speed or flexibility. It was built on pressure, timing and a small set of moves done extremely well. That is exactly what the Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys series teaches.

This bundle brings all six courses of the series together. Each one covers a different part of the game, and together they give you a full, connected system you can use from the first grip to the finish.

You start on top with the Pressure Passing System, where Bernardo shows how to pass the guard with weight and position instead of explosiveness. When you end up on the bottom, the Half Guard System gives you a safe, reliable guard to sweep and come back on top.

When things go wrong, Positional Escapes From Everywhere and Submission Escapes cover the defense: how to get out of bad positions and how to escape the most common submissions without wasting energy or risking injury.

Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions shows you how to pin your partner down and finish with simple, high-percentage attacks that do not depend on athleticism.

Omoplata From Everywhere adds one more attack to the system: the omoplata from closed guard, butterfly, half guard, side control, mount and against the turtle, with the finishes for every way your partner tries to roll out of it.

Every technique is chosen with the older or less athletic grappler in mind: low risk, efficient and easy to remember. If you want to keep improving and keep enjoying jiu-jitsu for many years, this is the bundle for you.

Courses Included In This Bundle

  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Pressure Passing System by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Half Guard System by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Positional Escapes From Everywhere by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Submission Escapes by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys: Omoplata From Everywhere by Bernardo Faria
